description:
Replace emoji status markers in CLI human-readable output with words.

## Background

Human-readable command output marks status with emoji and pictographs (for example ❌ ⚠ ✓ ✗ ✅ 🌐) in validation, gate, document and initialization output. They render inconsistently across terminals, add width ambiguity, and carry no information that the adjacent text does not. Configurable type icons are a separate, repository-declared feature and stay as they are.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: No command's human-readable status output contains an emoji or pictographic status marker; each is replaced by a word such as `error`, `warning` or `ok`, or removed where the text already states the status.
- [hard] REQ-02: Type icons declared by a repository or defaulted by hierarchy level are unchanged.
- [hard] REQ-03: One test fails when a pictographic status marker is reintroduced into CLI output outside the type-icon mechanism.
- [hard] REQ-04: Documentation examples of command output match the new text.
title: Replace emoji status markers in CLI output with words
